turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Compress to floor]
    C1 --> C2[Name evaporated content and function]
    C2 --> C3[Locate operative sentence]
    C3 --> C4[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
    C4 --> C5[Output finding]
    C5 --> C6["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    C6 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> E{Mode stated or inferable?}
    E -->|No| E1[Ask for mode]
    E1 --> E
    E -->|Yes| F[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    F --> G{HUMAN mode?}
    G -->|Yes| G1[Run the speak test]
    G1 --> H{Floor passes?}
    G -->|No| H
    H -->|No, 3 or fewer gaps| H1[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    H1 --> F
    H -->|No, 4 or more gaps| H2[Ask three largest gaps]
    H2 --> H3[Assume the remaining gaps aloud]
    H3 --> F
    H -->|Yes| I[Compress the prompt]
    I --> J{Cut removed specification?}
    J -->|Yes| J1[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    J1 --> J2[Revert to last passing version]
    J2 --> I
    J -->|No| K{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    K -->|No| L{Floor still passes?}
    L -->|No| M[Return last passing version]
    M --> N[Output the contract]
    L -->|Yes| N
    K -->|Yes| N
    N --> O["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]

    O -->|Keep negotiating| I
    O -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| P{Named human signer and full contract immediately above?}
    P -->|No| O
    P -->|Yes| Q{Execution tools available?}
    Q -->|No| Q1[Gate stays closed]
    Q1 --> Z
    Q -->|Yes| R["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    R --> S[Execute exactly as frozen]
    S --> T{Result}
    T -->|Success| U[Done]
    T -->|Floor failure| V["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    V --> I
```
